snippet.title: Adhain - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4302350

Adhain is a god simulator and city builder where the world is your playground. Play alone or with up to 3 friends as you pick up and throw almost anything, from trees to boulders, and even start fires that spread across the land.

Your power is limited to the areas where people believe in you, win over new villages to expand your influence. Your creature is the exception to this rule, starting out young and inexperienced, it learns by observing you, your villagers, and even other creatures. Train it well, and it becomes a true extension of your power, able to cast miracles and act in areas where you can’t.

Become the god you want to be and bring the land under your control - whether through kindness or fear.
